role: 'Delete All My Data' orchestrator: awaits CloudKit zone deletion, sweeps every file in App Group/Application Support/Documents/Caches/tmp and every UserDefaults key (minus keep-lists), then resets named stores (archive dirs, keychain, AI stores, settings, breadcrumbs, caches, notifications) and returns a localized Report.
types: DataPurgeService.Report: struct — per-step booleans (profileReset among them), residual counts, errors, localized text
DataPurgeService.ReadBack: struct — the outcomes read back from the stores after the steps
DataPurgeService.PurgeScope: struct (@MainActor) — where a purge sweeps files and preferences: App Group container, sandbox roots, preference suites; .device in production
state: mem:DataPurgeService.defaultsKeepList = entitlement.anchor.v1, storekit.lastKnownPurchased, storekit.lastKnownTestFlight, storekit.verifiedProductionInstall, storekit.verifiedXcodeInstall

units.does: Runs the purge: remote CloudKit deletion (awaited), container file sweep (keeping only the live settings file, settingsManager.settingsURL) + in-memory archive reset, UserDefaults sweep, named directory/store resets, a reset of the personal baseline tracker (the one passed, else RRCollector.current's), debug/crash log purge, then reads the settings file back (readBackProfile) and every other store whose clear reports no failure (readBackClearedStores) and returns a Report whose per-step booleans are those results. The file and preference sweeps and the archive/backup directory resets run in `scope` (default .device, the app's own containers and suites; tests pass temporary ones); the keychain, assistant stores, settings, CloudKit local state, logs, breadcrumbs and workout track backups are always the app's own.

branches.effect: that tracker is reset; nil: RRCollector.current's tracker, or none when there is no collector

units.does: After all purge steps, checks each store the report would otherwise assume cleared: CloudKit lastSyncDate nil and zoneCreated false; the conversation file empty or gone once the store's queued clear has run (ConversationStore.isEmptyOnDisk — unreadable or undecodable counts as not cleared); UserFactsStore.facts empty and the facts file holding no facts once its queued write has run (persistedFacts); SettingsManager.hasAcceptedDisclaimer false; the assistant disclaimer false in UserDefaults and in the view model; UnitsPreferenceStore.current == .auto; and no breadcrumb active.json or archive.json (checked on the store's queue, after its pending clear/erase).
UserSettings() with iCloudSyncEnabled = false: the settings purgeLocalStores leaves, which readBackProfile expects on disk.

The Profile step: asks the settings manager to flush its pending write and compare the file with purgedSettings (flushedFileHolds). Returns true when the file holds them; otherwise appends a localized 'Profile: ...' error (the saved settings still hold an earlier profile, or the write/read/decode error) and returns false.

branches.effect: error 'Profile: the saved settings still hold an earlier profile', false

branches.cond: flush write, read or decode threw

units.does: Resets the given personal baseline tracker (forgets every stored night in memory and saves the empty baseline); nothing when nil.
Sweeps every container of the scope, keeping only the live settings file, then resets SessionArchive and RawRRBackup in-memory indexes and posts .flowRecoveryArchiveChanged.
The entry names the sweep keeps in `root`: the live settings file's name when root is the directory that file is in (both compared with symlinks resolved and standardized), otherwise none.

branches.cond: root is not the live settings file's directory

units.does: False for keys on the keep list, FlowRecovery.migration.* keys, didRun* keys that carry a _v version marker, and system-owned keys (isSystemKey: a system prefix followed by a capital, digit, underscore or nothing); true otherwise.

True when key starts with prefix and either the prefix ends with '.', the key is exactly the prefix, or the next character is uppercase, a digit or '_' (Apple's key style); a lowercase continuation is not a system key.

branches.cond: prefix ends with '.' or nothing follows it

Removes every top-level entry of root whose name is not in the kept set, counting successes and appending a localized error per failure. A root that does not exist is skipped (0); one that exists but cannot be listed appends 'Could not list <name>: <error>' and returns 0.

branches.effect: returns 0, no error (nothing there to remove)

Purges debug log and crash logs (reporting each) and clears the PendingEncryptionLedger.

units.does: Purges workout GPS backups, resets CloudKit local sync state, removes all API keys from the Keychain, clears the assistant conversation (view model and store) and user facts, resets settings to defaults with iCloud sync OFF, removes ud AssistantViewModel.disclaimerKey (assistant.disclaimerAccepted), sets units to .auto, clears breadcrumb active trail and archive, and resets in-memory location/contact/artifact stores, the display and training-load caches, and AI consents. Returns whether keychain removal fully succeeded.
writes: file:Breadcrumbs/active.json (async on BreadcrumbStore queue; verified by readBackClearedStores)

units.does: Cancels scheduled morning notifications and removes all delivered notifications.

Disengages the ActiveRouteSession (memory-only turn-by-turn route), then calls forgetAfterPurge on SavedRouteStore, BreadcrumbRecorder, AmbientLocationService, EmailContactStore, AssistantArtifactStore, UIStateCache and TrainingMetricsCache, then revokes assistant agreements.
Revokes consent for every provider requiring it and sets the assistant view model's hasAcceptedDisclaimer false.
writes: ud:ProviderConsentTracker storageKey/grantedAt keys per provider (removed, ProviderConsentTracker.swift:129-130)

units.does: Clears the debug logger (memory, pending lines, and a queued removal of its file), then synchronously deletes debug_log.txt at the logger's own path (AppConfig.sharedContainerURL(), App Group or its Documents fallback) if present — the log re-created by logging during the purge, after the sweep removed the original; returns false and records an error only if that deletion throws.
Clears crash logs; on throw records 'Crash logs: <error>' and returns false.

Clears the heat-acclimation cache (HeatAcclimationCache.clear(): persisted readout and legacy coordinates, the in-memory readout and any refresh in flight), LLM cache telemetry, LLM request audit, SleepDataCache, RespiratoryBaselineCache, WristTemperatureBaselineCache and the recovery-score feedback store; a feedback log that cannot be removed appends 'Recovery score feedback: <error>'.
